title: Survey stations close enough
description: No station is farther than maximum_step in measured depth after the station before it (included). The step is the MD minus the previous MD, times 0.3048 when the depth unit is ft; a survey whose declared depth unit is neither m nor ft is not applicable (no-column). The example depth is the station's measured depth as written and its value the step in m.

parameters.name: maximum_step
parameters.source: 30 CFR 250.461(b): surveys of a directional well give inclination and azimuth at intervals not to exceed 500 feet (152.4 m) during the normal course of drilling.

words.template: {count} stations are more than {maximum_step} after the station before, the first at {first}.
